heading: INT. LIBRARY OF MOTHS - THE HOLLOW TOWER - NIGHT

units.text: INT. LIBRARY OF MOTHS - THE HOLLOW TOWER - NIGHT
Shelves rise into darkness, thick with bound ledgers.
Pale moths cover every spine, their wings turning the pages by themselves.
ORRIN, a young knight in dented mail, steps through the arch, sword half-drawn.
At his side, SABLE, a thief with a hooded cloak and a crooked smile, carries a lantern whose flame burns blue.
Quiet. They sleep.
units.name: ORRIN

units.text: They're moths, Orrin. They don't sleep.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: TAMSIN, a girl of twelve in an apprentice's smock, scurries from behind a shelf, arms full of scrolls, and nearly collides with them.
All three freeze.
You are not supposed to be here.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: No one is.
units.name: SABLE

units.text: The moths lift in a silent cloud.
Orrin's sword rings free.
Sable ducks, Tamsin shrieks, scrolls scatter, and the three tumble together into the center aisle, tangled in cloak and chain.
A hush falls.
VESPER, tall and thin, robed in gray, steps from between the shelves.
Her face is a smooth mask of bone-white silk.
She raises one hand.
The moths settle.
The Archivist welcomes you. Now put down the lantern.
units.name: VESPER
